answer: The atlas index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 718 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the quill. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the ledge queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. That is 15 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
